create_siglip2_image_processor: create a Siglip2ImageProcessorPil instance with custom patch_size and max_num_patches for image preprocessing
build_image_patches: build a 2D array of image patches from a 3D numpy array using convert_image_to_patches with a given patch_size
pad_image_patches: pad a numpy array of patches along the first dimension to a target length and return the padded array with attention mask
compute_image_size_for_patches: compute target image height and width for a given patch_size and max_num_patches using binary search
preprocess_siglip2_images: preprocess a batch of PIL or numpy images into pixel_values, pixel_attention_mask, and spatial_shapes tensors
